# Third-party provenance

No complete third-party source tree or binary is vendored here. See [`../CREDITS.md`](../CREDITS.md) for the audited source links, exact revisions, authorship, licenses, and reference-only restrictions.

The only upstream-derived material stored in this directory is `ps4-payload-sdk-zig-compat.patch`. It records project-authored compatibility changes against `Scene-Collective/ps4-payload-sdk` commit `b7326416c23ce14639e9180a24093bdc5eedb579`. The pinned SDK revision contains no license file, so the SDK must be obtained directly from upstream and must not be redistributed as part of this repository.

The patch's original modifications are offered under `GPL-3.0-or-later`. That grant covers only this project's changes and does not relicense the upstream lines included as patch context.
